data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts the generator is 'unfair' based on a theoretical heuristic about LCG serial correlation, but the problem defines fair purely numerically (counts within two SD of 10000/6) and states only an exact tally can establish it. A deterministic LCG's local hyperplane correlation says nothing about whether the aggregate counts fall within this specific tolerance. The reasoning commits to an outcome ('produces an unfair distribution') without any simulation evidence, despite the problem explicitly requiring the recurrence to be run and tallied before any tally is used as evidence.
